item.description: Rail Travel Gets Pricier Again: Long-Distance Passengers Hit, Daily Commuters Spared. item.title: 14 injured in stabbing, liquid spray attack in Japan
item.description: At least 14 people were injured in a stabbing attack in Japan, during which an unspecified liquid was also sprayed, an emergency services official said. item.title: TB burden remains high in Gujarat despite elimination claims
item.description: A significant gap between official claims and ground reality has emerged in Gujarat’s fight against tuberculosis (TB). In 2025 alone, 1,27,876 TB cases have already been registered, translating to an average of 357 new cases every day. Although this represents a slight decline from last year’s total of approximately 1.37 lakh cases, Gujarat continues to rank fifth among Indian states reporting the highest TB burden. item.title: Third T20I between India and Sri Lanka Women’s Teams scheduled at 7 PM Today
item.description: In Women’s Cricket, the third T20 International between India and Sri Lanka will be played at Greenfield International Stadium, Thiruvananthapuram, today. The match will start at 7 pm. The hosts have taken a 2-0 lead in the five-match series. India defeated Sri Lanka by eight wickets in the first game on Sunday and won the second game by seven wickets on Tuesday in Visakhapatnam.
